alibabacloud-pai-resource-group-management v0.0.1

- Initial public release with end-to-end lifecycle management for Alibaba Cloud PAI ResourceGroups via the `aliyun paistudio` CLI.
- Strengthened observability: every business API CLI call now mandates a unique session-level `--user-agent` flag for traceability.
- Refined command discipline: configuration/system commands must NOT receive `--user-agent`.
- MachineGroup deletion remains strictly out of scope.
- Updated trigger phrases and required permissions for broader coverage and tighter access control.
- Extensive documentation and validation reference updates; obsolete `skill-card.md` removed.

Initial beta release introducing end-to-end Alibaba Cloud PAI ResourceGroup lifecycle management.

- Supports list, get, create, update, and delete operations for ECS and Lingjun PAI ResourceGroups via the `aliyun paistudio` CLI plugin.
- Enables read-only inspection of MachineGroups and binding/unbinding of UserVpc (where supported).
- Enforces strict AI-Mode initialization and cleanup commands on all operations.
- Implements comprehensive pre-execution validation, branching, and confirmation workflows per operation.
- Provides clear guidance and restrictions around out-of-scope actions, such as MachineGroup deletion and deprecated metrics APIs.
